standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.player: It's nice to see another human face around here.

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.npc: Leave me be, peasant - I am relaxing.
Do you know who I am?

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.player: I'm sorry, I haven't had the privilege.

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.npc: I, peasant, am Robin, Master Bowman. I am very famous you know.

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.player: Oh, Robin, Master Bowman, I see.

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.npc: So have you heard of me?
Would you do me a favour? I appear to have run out of bed linen. Can you run along to the innkeeper and get me a clean bedsheet?

options.text: Anything for a famous person such as yourself.

steps.player: Anything for a famous person such as yourself.

steps.npc: Now that sounds more like it. Run along now, get me my sheet.
Oh charming. You just can't get the staff these days.

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy-wit.player: I've brought you a clean bedsheet, Robin.

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy-wit.npc: Well it's about time. Run along now, I need some Robin time.

standard-dialogue-after-ghosts-ahoy.npc: Do you want another game of Runedraw?

standard-dialogue-using-the-right-click-.text: Without at least the medium Morytania Diary completed:

steps.npc: Sorry, my orders are that I can only give slime to those who have completed the Morytania medium, hard or elite diaries.
There's a diary master in Canifis, go and speak to her.

standard-dialogue-using-the-right-click-.text: If the player has no bones in their inventory:

steps.npc: You do not have any bones for me to convert for you.

standard-dialogue-using-the-right-click-.text: If the player has bones in their inventory:

steps.text: If the player has hit their daily limit:

steps.npc: You have already claimed your daily slime and bonemeal. Come back again tomorrow for some more.

steps.text: If the player does not have enough free inventory slots:

steps.npc: You do not have enough space for both bonemeal and slime. Come back to me when you have space.

steps.text: Robin hands you some buckets of slime and bonemeal.

treasure-trails-master-if-the-player-doe.npc: As THE Master Bowman, I am quite impressed by your equipment, but it's not the sort I'd recommend myself. Try more conventional forms of accuracy enhancement.

treasure-trails-master-if-the-player-has.npc: As THE Master Bowman, I am most impressed by your equipment, peasant.

treasure-trails-master-if-the-player-has.text: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
